missing_units.boundary: Agent GUI input -> burst bookkeeping (restore-point snapshot, /workspace manifest, baseline pids, stray kill, gui_changes record). The dicts _gui_burst, _gui_input_at and _gui_snap_at are shared by tool-pool threads and human request threads with no lock. _snapshot registers the burst (agentbox/service.py:206-213, 258-268) before _run_tool stamps _gui_input_at (service.py:105-108, under gui_lock). close_idle_gui_bursts (250-256) treats a missing or stale stamp as idle, so a concurrent poll could close a just-opened burst. decide() (384-422) takes neither _snap_locks nor _busy, so approved calls run a parallel path to call_tool.
missing_units.attack_class: Race and check-then-act on security-control state: burst open versus idle-close ordering, double close or open, approved-path parity with call_tool, control-plane restart dropping bursts. Mitigation is only partial (the accepted N-1 GUI bypass).
